documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                   ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS DIVISION


                                    DOCKET NUMBER U-37882


                           ENTERGY LOUISIANA, LLC, EX PARTE


In re: Application ofEntergy Louisiana, LLCfor Certiﬁcation of Generation and Transmission
Resources and for Other Relief Pursuant to the Commission ’s Lightning Initiative



                            RULING ON UNOPPOSED MOTION
                       TO MODIFY THE PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE


       HAVING     CONSIDERED           the   Unopposed      Joint   Motion to      Modify   the   Procedural
Schedule filed by the Louisiana Public Service Commission (“LPSC” or “Commission”) Staff on

July 9, 2026 (“Motion”),

       IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the Motion is granted.                   Accordingly,

       PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the current procedural schedule is modiﬁed as follows:


       July 24, 2026           Deadline for Commission Staff and lntervenor Direct Testimony.



       August 19, 2026         Deadline for Commission Staff and lntervenor Cross—Answering

                               Testimony.

                               Deadline      for   the   issuance   of   discovery on Direct
                                                                         written

                               Testimony (l5—day turnaround, with best efforts to respond within
                               10 days).


       September 4, 2026       Deadline for Entergy Louisiana, LLC Rebuttal Testimony.


       September 22,2026       Deadline      for the     issuance   of written     discovery   on   Entergy
                               Louisiana, LLC ’s Rebuttal Testimony (7—day turnaround).

       September 28, 2026      Deadline to ﬁle a Joint Pre-Hearing Statement, which contains:


                               1.    A list of all witnesses and agreed upon order of presentation;
                               2.    A list of uncontested issues agreed upon by the parties; and
                               3.    A list of contested issues.


       October 7-20, 2026      Hearing. A hearing in this proceeding will be convened at 9:30
                               A.M. on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 and continue as needed

                               through Tuesday, October 20, 2026 in the 15‘ Floor Natchez
                               Room of the Galvez Building, 602 North Fifth Street, Baton

                               Rouge, Louisiana.
        All parties intending to present evidence at the hearing shall bring a copy of each exhibit
for the court reporter, as well as additional copies for the judge, the research attorney, and all other

parties to the proceeding. Hearing exhibits presented to the court reporterfor admission into the
hearing record shall be single—sided. Exhibits not easily printed, such as Excel spreadsheets, may
be provided on an electronic storage device that is appropriately identiﬁed, marked as conﬁdential
or public, and maintained in such a way to ensure that the device is not damaged in handling.

While CDs are accepted, thumb drives are preferred.


        Compliance with Rule 6 of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure is required
if the parties wish to proceed by stipulation. Accordingly, a contradictory hearing will not be
converted, nor will an uncontested stipulation hearing be scheduled. until the parties have complied
with Rule 6.


       If you require    special accommodation at the hearing, please contact the Administrative
Hearings Division at (225) 219-9417 at least five days before the date of the hearing. Public
parking is available in the Galvez Garage on North Street across from the Galvez Building. Visitors
should take a picture of their license plate as they must provide detailed vehicle information within

thirty minutes of entry into the parking garage. Further instructions will be provided upon arrival
at the Commission.



       Baton Rouge, Louisiana, this 9"‘ day of July, 2026.
